files.name: mesh_sources.csv
files.condition: output.write_files=true for OBJ and template meshes

files.name: charge_ledger.csv
files.condition: output.write_files=true and charge ledger state is present
files.restart_role: conditional: required when summary contains ledger checkpoint metadata

files.name: outer_plasma_profile.csv
files.condition: output.write_files=true and a kinetic_1d or unified_linear_response outer state is ready
files.restart_role: conditional: required when resuming that ready outer state

files.name: photoelectron_histogram.csv
files.condition: output.write_files=true and outer_plasma.photoelectron_histogram_enabled=true and histogram state is ready
files.restart_role: conditional: required when resuming with photoelectron_histogram_enabled=true

files.name: rng_state.txt
files.condition: output.write_files=true; serial name or one file per MPI rank

files.name: macro_residuals.csv
files.condition: output.write_files=true and macro-particle residual state is allocated; one global file in serial and MPI
